description:
Start the climb of a lifetime: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014085/

On the Trail is a series of free DLCs for the award winning survival climbing game Cairn. Set out on the ascent of a lifetime with pro-climber Aava: climb anywhere, plan your route carefully, and manage your resources to survive the unforgiving ascent of Mount Kami. 

On the Trail brings climbers to new climbing locations and challenges. Find your route freely, solve fresh climbing problems and explore new iconic locations as you follow the trail of a legendary climber.

Cairn features realistic simulation that allows you to climb intuitively, anywhere. Find the best holds and place your hands and feet seamlessly with simple controls. Adapt your posture, effort and balance - if you're not careful, you will fall!

Arcadia Fallen II is now available on PS5 & PS4!

Outside the thick walls of your school, a storm is brewing. Feelings of mistrust in mages have been growing for years, whipped up by politicians with vested interests, and now the Academy itself is in the spotlight. What will you do when the storm sweeps through your school?

As you uncover the story of Arcadia Fallen II, you will decide how you respond to the people around you and the events that unfold. Tone labels help you avoid unexpected consequences, and choices with significant impact on the story are highlighted. But no matter what you decide to do, there are no “wrong” choices and no dead ends. Only you can find the path that is right for you.
